exposure: weight difference between the index trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) sonographic estimated fetal weight (sEFW) and prior delivery birth weight
cohort: Women with prior cesarean for labor dystocia and no prior vaginal delivery undergoing TOLAC between March 2011 and June 2020 with a sEFW within 1 week from delivery
finding: Higher maternal age, induction of labor, and higher birth weight were independently negatively associated with TOLAC success in women with prior labor dystocia and no previous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study investigated the association between sonographic estimated fetal weight and the success rate of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) in women with prior labor dystocia and no prior vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Mean sEFW and birth weight were lower in the TOLAC success group
